data.body:
[P1] Release checkpoint draining when the deadline passes

If a checkpoint request is pending here, termination blocks new enqueues, but the wrapper still awaits `waitForQueueCompletion()` before handling the deadline. `processQueue()` also sends updates queued behind that request. A stalled request therefore delays `InvocationDeadlineError`, plugin notification, and cleanup beyond the deadline. For deadline termination, abandon unsent updates and release the wrapper's wait without resuming operation callers, while preserving ordinary fault draining. Add a regression that expects the deadline error before releasing a held checkpoint request.
